arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Rosenberg argued the tax violates Section 111. He stated it discriminates based on compensation source. He said only state plans receive the exemption.
Ms. See argued the taxpayer must show different treatment. She cited the Jefferson County decision. She emphasized the need for similar state employee comparison.
Mr. Huston agreed the tax is facially discriminatory. He stated this is the critical feature. He addressed questions about state employee categories.
